profile_text.body:
RICHTECH ROBOTICS INC. is a for-profit public company headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, with the ticker RR and SEC CIK number 0001963685. Its website is rolls-royce.com. The content on that website describes Rolls-Royce, which says it has spent more than 100 years at the forefront of innovation and develops complex power and propulsion solutions for safety-critical applications in the air, at sea and on land. Rolls-Royce describes itself as pioneering cutting-edge technologies that deliver clean, safe and competitive solutions to meet the planet's vital power needs.

The website lists several announcements. Rolls-Royce says it completed a $1 billion investment in Indiana, making Indianapolis one of the most advanced engine manufacturing and test campuses in the world. It also announced a strategic intent with Reliance Industries to develop India's indigenous combat engine for the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft programme, cooperation with the United Kingdom National Nuclear Laboratory and Japan Atomic Energy Agency on advanced nuclear technologies, and multiple contractual commitments for Rolls-Royce SMR units in Europe after signing a contract with CEZ Group.

No products, including AI products, are recorded for RICHTECH ROBOTICS INC. No litigation cases are recorded, and the company has no Nevada law exposure entries. It is listed under the aliases RICHTECH ROBOTICS INC. and RICHTECH ROBOTICS INC-CL B.
